name: amaterasu
description: Monorepo for ProjectAmaterasu: web, REST API and Proxmox tooling

scripts.start:mock: cd amaterasu-proxmox/mock && pnpm install && pnpm start
scripts.test:web: cd amaterasu-web && pnpm exec ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadlessCI
scripts.deps:lock: for r in amaterasu-proxmox/requirements amaterasu-populate/requirements requirements-dev; do uv pip compile --quiet --universal --generate-hashes --python-version 3.14 $r.in -o $r.txt; done
scripts.deps:upgrade: for r in amaterasu-proxmox/requirements amaterasu-populate/requirements requirements-dev; do uv pip compile --quiet --universal --generate-hashes --upgrade --python-version 3.14 $r.in -o $r.txt; done
scripts.push:git: git push gitlab main && git push github main
